notes.title: Video streaming and uploading rules for "Touhou Tenkuushou ~ Hidden Star in Four Seasons."
notes.notes:
Please note that we prohibit streaming or uploading video footage of "Touhou Tenkuushou ~ Hidden Star in Four Seasons." featuring the following:

[list]
    [*] Any display of endings shown after completing Stage 6
    [*] Any replaying of music through the Music Room
[/list]

All other gameplay footage may be freely used.

notes.title: Touhou 16 shoots onto Steam
notes.notes:
Touhou is a phenomenon. Despite niche appeal, this long-running series of bullet hell shmups has grown into an enormous shared franchise in Japan. It’s an indie scene unto itself, enabled by creator Zun giving his blessing to people making and selling fan works. Touhou boasts twice-yearly conventions dense with cosplayers, multiple official comic lines and fan-made works including music, anime, and games spanning every genre, including boozy RTSs and even football RPGs. And yet, it’s still an almost impenetrable mystery to those standing on the outside.

That barrier has become a lot easier to traverse yesterday, as Touhou 16: Hidden Star In Four Seasons has arrived on Steam, accompanied by a three-level free demo, and a comprehensive – albeit unofficial – localization patch.

Update: The full release of the game came with a little more DRM than anticipated. The Touhou translation crew are attempting to work around it. Please wait warmly until it is ready.

Update Again: Well, that was fast. The translation patch is fully compatible with the Steam version of the game now.

(more…)

notes.title: On Steam services and features in "Touhou Tenkuushou ～ Hidden Star in Four Seasons."
notes.notes:
"Touhou Tenkuushou ～ Hidden Star in Four Seasons." uses only the Steam Cloud service.
Game settings, saved data, and in-game screenshots (P key) will be automatically saved to Steam Cloud.

Other Steam features have not been enabled at this time.

Thank you.

--

(In Japanese)
"東方天空璋 ～ Hidden Star in Four Seasons."につきましては、Steamクラウドのみ設定されています。
ゲームのコンフィグ、セーブデータ、ゲーム内の撮影機能（Pキー）によるスクリーンショットが自動的にクラウドに保存されます。

その他Steamの機能については現時点では使用されていませんのでご承知おきください。

notes.title: A demo version of "Touhou Tenkuushou ～ Hidden Star in Four Seasons." has been posted
notes.notes:
We have published a demo version of "Touhou Tenkuushou ～ Hidden Star in Four Seasons."

This is the same version as the demo distributed at Reitaisai 14.

In addition to using this demo to try the game out, please also use this version to confirm that the full game will work on your PC.

--

(In Japanese)
皆さん既にお気づきのことかと思いますが、"東方天空璋 ～ Hidden Star in Four Seasons."のデモ版を配信いたしました。
こちらは第十四回博麗神社例大祭にて配布された"東方天空璋 ～ Hidden Star in Four Seasons."の体験版と同様の内容となります。
（一部ファイルのみ同梱しておりません）

"東方天空璋 ～ Hidden Star in Four Seasons."の動作を確認するものとしてもご利用ください。
